title: Classification Benchmarks for Under-resourced Bengali Language based on Multichannel Convolutional-LSTM Network
findings: The proposed Multichannel Convolutional-LSTM (MConv-LSTM) model, especially when enhanced with pre-trained BengFastText word embeddings, demonstrated high effectiveness in identifying religious hate speech. In performance evaluations, the model achieved an Area Under the Curve (AUC) score of 0.98 for the 'Religious' hate speech category, indicating strong predictive accuracy for this type of content.
